$comment: D443 T1: the local text and vision model that Ujwalam starts itself after a stream (services/local-model/runner.mjs). Files come from Settings > Downloads (data/downloads/local-model.json): items serverItem and modelItem land in <models>/<dest>. gpuLayers: 'auto' offloads all layers when free VRAM >= vramNeedMiB, a share of them when at least minGpuMiB is free, else none (CPU). A start on the GPU that fails is tried once more on the CPU. vramNeedMiB measured in docs/evidence/2026-11-24-d443-t1-model-runner.md.
